run_inference_on_image_pairs: run inference on a list of image pairs using a DUSt3R model with configurable batch size
run_inference_mv_on_batch: run multi-view inference on a batch of images using a DUSt3R model on a specified device
compute_loss_of_one_batch: compute the loss for a single batch of image pairs using a model and criterion with optional symmetric batching
compute_loss_of_one_batch_mv: compute the loss for a single multi-view batch using a model and criterion with optional AMP support
find_optimal_scaling_between_pointclouds: find the optimal scaling factor between ground truth and predicted 3D point clouds using Weiszfeld or average methods
